summary: [Web] Work order Services: on a work order with more than 500 assets, adding a service to all of them fails and the whole work order screen is replaced by an error
desc:
h3. Simple explanation
On a big work order (more than 500 assets), a user selects all the assets, opens *Services* and adds a service, for example Cleaning.
The service is not added to any asset. Instead the whole work order screen disappears and only an error line and a *Back to Work Orders* button are left.
This happens because the web app sends all the selected assets in one request, but the server accepts at most 500 assets per request.
It matters because adding a service to every asset is a normal step on large work orders: a customer's 1,512-asset work order hit this on production on 13 Oct.
It should add the service to all the selected assets (sending them in groups of up to 500), and if anything does go wrong, show a short message and keep the work order open.

!ZP-4840-key-highlighted.png|width=720!

h3. Actual result
After *Add*, the work order page is replaced by "Failed to add service: API call failed: 400 ... at most 500 assets per request ...", with only a *Back to Work Orders* button. No service is added to any asset.

h3. Expected result
The service is added to all the selected assets (the web app sends them in groups of up to 500). If something fails, a short message appears in the dialog or as a toast, and the work order page stays open.

h3. Test data
* Environment: QA https://acme.qa.egalvanic.ai, re-checked 14 Oct 2026 on build index-G6uKkjPx.js (screenshots) and again on index-D-HsTlcR.js after the afternoon redeploy (same result)
* Role / test login: Project Manager abhiyant.singh+project@egalvanic.com
* QA work order used for the proof (QA's own test data, nothing was changed): https://acme.qa.egalvanic.ai/sessions/22a22b9c-4eda-43ed-b131-4b7146912441 ("QA-DEMO ZP-4801 Tuned column (delete me)", site "Android Site 2", *Select all* picks 222 assets)
* To see it end to end you need an OPEN work order with more than 500 assets. QA has none open today (97 open work orders, the largest has 342 assets). The closed work order "AutoTest_WO_85105" on site "test site" has 1,076 assets: https://acme.qa.egalvanic.ai/sessions/90a59769-5998-4847-94a2-af169ffad035. A new work order on "test site" with all its assets is the quickest way to get an open one.
* First seen on production (company Bass Electric, 13 Oct 2026): work order 1029 "D802 - 200 Paul Ave" with 1,512 assets, https://basselectric.egalvanic.ai/sessions/a898ad5e-e3dc-48a5-b0f3-7ab64233c9b7 (screen recording attached: bug_service_bulk.mp4). Please do not repeat *Add* on this customer work order.

h3. Steps to reproduce
1. Sign in to https://acme.qa.egalvanic.ai as the Project Manager and open a work order that is still open and has more than 500 assets (see Test data).
2. On the *Assets* tab click *Bulk Ops* (the button then reads *Cancel*), tick the checkbox in the table header, then click *Select all <N>*. (Screenshot 1, QA)
!ZP-4840-2-QA-14Oct-bulk-ops-select-all-services.png|width=720!
3. Click *Services*. The "Manage Services - <N> assets" dialog opens. Under *Add a service* choose *Cleaning* and click *Add*. (Screenshot 2, production: 1,512 assets)
!1-manage-services-1512-assets-add-cleaning.png|width=720!
4. The work order screen is replaced by the error and a *Back to Work Orders* button; no service is added. (Screenshot 3, production; Screenshot 4, the same screen on QA today)
!2-failed-to-add-service-at-most-500-assets.png|width=720!
!ZP-4840-3-QA-14Oct-same-error-replaces-work-order-page.png|width=720!
5. Proof of the cause on QA, nothing changed (Screenshot 5): signed in as the Project Manager, QA sent the add request for the QA-DEMO work order above with made-up asset ids and a made-up service id, so nothing can match (re-run on 14 Oct with the same answers):
!ZP-4840-1-PM-QA-add-assets-cap-500-mechanism.png|width=720!
{noformat}
add-assets with 501 asset ids  -> 400 "at most 500 assets per request"
add-assets with 500 asset ids  -> 400 "no addable assets (unknown, deleted, or on another site)"  (control)
{noformat}

h3. Notes for the developer
* The bulk *Manage Services > Add* handler (work order page) sends ALL selected asset ids in ONE {{POST /api/ir_session/<work order id>/add-assets}} call (QA saw all 222 ids in one call); on failure it sets the page-level error, which replaces the whole work order view.
* How Screenshot 4 was made: on the 222-asset QA-DEMO work order QA let the real *Add* request through to the server as 501 made-up asset ids (request size simulated, so nothing could be added). The server's answer and the app's reaction on screen are real.
* The server limit (500 assets per request) is working as designed; the web app does not respect it when *Select all* picks more than 500.
* Removing a service from all assets in the same dialog does NOT hit this limit (it sends one request per asset), but with 1,512 assets that can be 1,512 calls in a row; worth batching in the same fix.

summary: [Web] A customer user can read another company's quotes, including prices, just by knowing that company's site id
desc:
h3. Simple explanation
A signed-in customer user (not Egalvanic staff) can read another company's quotes: titles, status and prices.
The app never shows that other company's site to this user, so no screen leads to those quotes.
But if the user sends the quotes request with that company's site id, the server answers with that company's quotes, exactly as it does for the user's own sites.
This matters because one customer can see another customer's commercial information: what was quoted and for how much (three of these quotes are between 113,000 and 121,000).
The server already refuses this same user when they try to open that company's site, so it should refuse the quotes request in the same way.

!ZP-4841-key-highlighted-v2.png|width=720!

h3. Actual result
The quotes request for site "Saveland Avenue Lofts" (another company) answers 200 with that company's 6 quotes: title, status, type, total price and opportunity name. Examples: "EMP for SLD f86052b7..." abandoned, total 116,134.11; "Transformer-Repair" accepted, total 150.00. The same answer also carries each quote's description, scope-of-work, contact and hours fields (empty or short on these 6 quotes).

h3. Expected result
The quotes request is refused (permission denied), the same answer the server already gives this user when they try to open that company's site.

h3. Test data
* Environment: https://acme.qa.egalvanic.ai, re-checked 14 Oct 2026 on build index-G6uKkjPx.js (screenshots) and again on index-D-HsTlcR.js after the afternoon redeploy (same result)
* Role / test login: Project Manager abhiyant.singh+project@egalvanic.com (customer user, not staff; 116 sites, the other company's site is not one of them). On 13 Oct the same result was seen as Account Manager abhiyant.singh+accountm@egalvanic.com, Electrical Engineer abhiyant.singh+electric@egalvanic.com and Facility Manager abhiyant.singh+fm@egalvanic.com
* Quotes page (type the address; this Project Manager has no Quotes item in the menu, but the page opens): https://acme.qa.egalvanic.ai/opportunities
* Other company's site: "Saveland Avenue Lofts", id f86052b7-1683-431f-a86f-f52c6dd5be39 (not in Acme's site list; even the Acme Super Admin is refused when opening it)
* The user's own site (control): "Android Site 2", id aadcee4c-7dd0-45b3-81b9-309c5c166084 -> its own 17 quotes

h3. Steps to reproduce
1. Sign in to https://acme.qa.egalvanic.ai as the Project Manager abhiyant.singh+project@egalvanic.com.
2. Type https://acme.qa.egalvanic.ai/opportunities in the address bar. Click *New Quote* and type {{Saveland}} in *Facility*: it says *No options*, because that site belongs to another company. (Control: typing {{Richmond}} lists "Richmond, CA".) (Screenshot 1)
!ZP-4841-1-PM-14Oct-new-quote-Saveland-no-options-highlighted.png|width=720!
3. Close the dialog, open the browser console (F12) on the same page and run:
{noformat}
fetch('/api/quote/by-sld/f86052b7-1683-431f-a86f-f52c6dd5be39').then(r=>r.json()).then(console.log)
{noformat}
4. The answer is 200 with that company's 6 quotes and their totals. (The key screenshot at the top)
5. Controls, same user and console:
{noformat}
fetch('/api/sld/f86052b7-1683-431f-a86f-f52c6dd5be39').then(r=>console.log(r.status))              // 422 - opening the site is refused
fetch('/api/opportunity/by-sld/f86052b7-1683-431f-a86f-f52c6dd5be39').then(r=>console.log(r.status)) // 422 - refused
fetch('/api/quote/by-sld/aadcee4c-7dd0-45b3-81b9-309c5c166084').then(r=>r.json()).then(console.log)  // own site - 17 quotes (correct)
{noformat}

h3. Notes for the developer
* {{quote/by-sld/<id>}} and {{quote/by-sld/<id>/lightweight}} (both return the same 6 quotes) lack the site-access check ({{@require_sld_access}}, which ZP-4585 extended with a company check) that {{sld/<id>}} and {{opportunity/by-sld/<id>}} already have.
* In the web app this request is made by the Planning page (/planning) when one site is picked.
* Same family as ZP-4709 ({{nodes/sld}}, library-designations), but this endpoint is not covered there.

summary: [Web] Creating a quote with a broken site id makes the server fail (internal error) instead of saying 'invalid site' (API only)
desc:
h3. Simple explanation
When the create-quote request is sent with a broken site id (not a valid id), the server fails with an internal error instead of a clear "invalid site id" message.
A normal user cannot reach this from the screen: the *New Quote* dialog only lets them pick a real site from a list, so it never sends a broken id.
It matters because a failing server request is noise in the error logs and is not the clean, clear answer the server should give for bad input.
Nothing is created by the request.
It should answer with a clear "invalid site id" message.

!ZP-4842-key-highlighted-v2.png|width=720!

h3. Actual result
The create-quote request with a broken site id ({{not-a-uuid}} or {{12345}}) answers 500 "internal_error" with a trace id. Nothing is created.

h3. Expected result
A clear "invalid site id" answer (400), not an internal error.

h3. Test data
* Environment: https://acme.qa.egalvanic.ai, re-checked 14 Oct 2026 on build index-G6uKkjPx.js (screenshots) and again on index-D-HsTlcR.js after the afternoon redeploy (same result)
* Role / test login: Project Manager abhiyant.singh+project@egalvanic.com (a customer user, not staff)
* Quotes page (type the address; this Project Manager has no Quotes item in the menu, but the page opens): https://acme.qa.egalvanic.ai/opportunities
* Reachable only by a request typed in the browser console; nothing was created

h3. Steps to reproduce
1. Sign in to https://acme.qa.egalvanic.ai as the Project Manager and type https://acme.qa.egalvanic.ai/opportunities in the address bar. In *New Quote* the *Facility* box only offers real sites from the list (typing another company's site name gives "No options"), so the screen cannot send a bad id. (Screenshot 1)
!ZP-4841-1-PM-14Oct-new-quote-Saveland-no-options-highlighted.png|width=720!
2. Close the dialog, open the browser console (F12) on the same page and run:
{noformat}
fetch('/api/quote/create-standard',{method:'POST',headers:{'Content-Type':'application/json','X-Direct-Write':'true'},body:JSON.stringify({sld_id:'not-a-uuid',title:'QA-DEMO probe (delete me)'})}).then(r=>console.log(r.status))
{noformat}
3. Repeat with {{sld_id:'12345'}}.
4. Both answer 500 "internal_error" with a trace id; nothing is created. (The key screenshot at the top)

h3. Notes for the developer
* API only: the Create Quote dialog only sends a site picked from the list, so no user sees this.
* The same broken-id failure also happens on {{GET /api/opportunity/<id>}} (ZP-4847) and the Bulk Edit endpoints (ZP-4855). Same class as ZP-4820 / ZP-4824 (both READY TO RELEASE).
* One shared id check on incoming site ids would fix all of these at once (answer 400 for a malformed id).

summary: [Web] With guest access turned off, typing the /guests address still opens the Guests admin page with an 'Invite guest' button
desc:
h3. Simple explanation
Guest access is a feature that can be switched on or off per company. For Acme on QA it is OFF.
With it OFF, the Admin menu correctly has no *Guests* item, so there is no link to the page.
But an admin user who types the /guests address into the browser still gets the Guests page, with an *Invite guest* button and a search box.
It matters because a switched-off feature should not open at all: the page looks half on and offers an action the company does not have (it shows no data).
It should show the normal "Feature Not Available" page, the same as other switched-off pages: /planning-board, which is also switched off for Acme, already does this.
Only admin users can open this page at all; other roles (checked: Project Manager) get "Access Denied", which is fine.

!ZP-4843-key-highlighted-v2.png|width=720!

*EXPECTED (mock-up):* !ZP-4843-expected-mockup.png|width=720!

h3. Actual result
Typing the /guests address opens the *Guests* page with an *Invite guest* button, a search box and an empty table ("No rows").

h3. Expected result
While guest access is off, /guests shows the normal "Feature Not Available" page (as /planning-board does today), matching the hidden menu item.

h3. Test data
* Environment: https://acme.qa.egalvanic.ai, re-checked 14 Oct 2026 on build index-G6uKkjPx.js (screenshots) and again on index-D-HsTlcR.js after the afternoon redeploy (same result)
* Role / test login: Super Admin abhiyant.singh+admin@egalvanic.com (this page is admin-only; the Project Manager abhiyant.singh+project@egalvanic.com gets "Access Denied")
* Page (typed in the address bar): https://acme.qa.egalvanic.ai/guests
* Control page (typed in the address bar): https://acme.qa.egalvanic.ai/planning-board, whose switch is also OFF for Acme; it shows "Feature Not Available"
* Switch values are the real ones (not simulated): {{feature-guest-access}} = false and {{feature-planned-work-v2}} = false for Acme on QA

h3. Steps to reproduce
1. Sign in to https://acme.qa.egalvanic.ai as the Super Admin abhiyant.singh+admin@egalvanic.com.
2. Click *Admin* in the left rail. Under *People* there are only *Platform Users* and *Guest Portal Users*; there is no *Guests* item (correct). (Screenshot 1)
!ZP-4843-1-SuperAdmin-14Oct-admin-menu-no-guests-highlighted.png|width=720!
3. Type https://acme.qa.egalvanic.ai/guests in the address bar and press Enter.
4. The *Guests* page opens with *Invite guest*, a search box and "No rows". (The key screenshot at the top)
5. Control: type https://acme.qa.egalvanic.ai/planning-board. It shows "Feature Not Available", which is what /guests should show. (Screenshot 2)
!ZP-4843-3-SuperAdmin-14Oct-planning-board-control.png|width=720!

h3. Notes for the developer
* Parent feature: ZP-4585 (cross-company guest access). Its own QA Review says "Flag off: ... confirm there is no ... Admin > People > Guests page".
* The menu item checks the feature switch ({{guest-access}} + {{users.manage}}), but the {{/guests}} route only checks {{features.settings.users.view}}. Wrap the route in the same feature gate that /planning-board, /reporting and /issue-suggestions use.
* The guest requests behind the page are refused (they come back as the app's web page, not data), so no data shows. QA did not click *Invite guest*. Impact is a dead page, not a data leak.

summary: [Web] Opening a report configuration link with a wrong or deleted id shows a completely blank page
desc:
h3. Simple explanation
A report configuration has its own link, which people can bookmark or share.
If that link points to a configuration that was later deleted, or the id in it is wrong, the page opens completely blank: no message and no link back to the list of report configurations.
The user cannot tell what happened; only the side menu and the browser Back button are left.
The realistic way this is hit is a saved or shared link to a configuration that no longer exists.
It should show a clear "Report configuration not found" message with a link back to the list of configurations.

!ZP-4846-key-highlighted-v2.png|width=720!

*EXPECTED (mock-up):* !ZP-4846-expected-mockup.png|width=720!

h3. Actual result
The page stays blank with no message, both for a well-formed id that has no configuration (like a deleted one) and for a malformed id. For the malformed id the server request for the configuration also answers with an internal error (500).

h3. Expected result
A clear "Report configuration not found" message with a link back to the list of configurations (Report Builder, https://acme.qa.egalvanic.ai/reporting/builder). The server answers 400/404 instead of an internal error.

h3. Test data
* Environment: https://acme.qa.egalvanic.ai, re-checked 14 Oct 2026 on build index-G6uKkjPx.js (screenshots) and again on index-D-HsTlcR.js after the afternoon redeploy (same result)
* Role / test login: Super Admin abhiyant.singh+admin@egalvanic.com
* Link to a configuration that does not exist (well-formed id, like a deleted configuration): https://acme.qa.egalvanic.ai/reporting/config/0b3f5d3e-1c2a-4e7b-9d4e-6a1b2c3d4e5f
* Mistyped link: https://acme.qa.egalvanic.ai/reporting/config/not-a-uuid
* Control, a real configuration that opens normally: https://acme.qa.egalvanic.ai/reporting/config/0eee082a-af4d-4805-9ae0-c19d3996af9a ("Annual Maintenance Report (Copy)")

h3. Steps to reproduce
1. Sign in to https://acme.qa.egalvanic.ai as Super Admin.
2. Open https://acme.qa.egalvanic.ai/reporting/config/0b3f5d3e-1c2a-4e7b-9d4e-6a1b2c3d4e5f (an id with no configuration behind it, the same as a link to a deleted configuration). Under the "Reporting" header the page stays blank. (The key screenshot at the top)
3. Open https://acme.qa.egalvanic.ai/reporting/config/not-a-uuid (a mistyped or cut-off link). The same blank page. (Screenshot 1)
!ZP-4846-1-SuperAdmin-14Oct-not-a-uuid-blank-highlighted.png|width=720!
4. In the browser console (F12): {{GET /api/reporting/configs/not-a-uuid}} (and {{.../preview-entities}}) answers 500 "An internal error occurred."; for the well-formed id it answers with the app's web page instead of a "not found" answer. (Screenshot 2)
!ZP-4846-2-SuperAdmin-reporting-config-api-500.png|width=720!
5. Control: https://acme.qa.egalvanic.ai/reporting/config/0eee082a-af4d-4805-9ae0-c19d3996af9a opens the "Edit Report Configuration" page normally.

h3. Notes for the developer
* When the configuration is not found, the editor only does {{console.error("Config not found:", id)}} and renders nothing.
* ZP-3347 (502 on this page, Done) was a different error.

summary: [Web] A customer user can download the full engineering file (SKM export) of another company's site, even though they are not allowed to open that site
desc:
h3. Simple explanation
A signed-in customer user (not Egalvanic staff) can get a download link for another company's whole engineering model: the SKM export of that site's equipment and how it is connected (375 equipment items and 193 connections for the site used here).
The app never shows that other company's site to this user, so no screen leads there.
But if the user sends the export request with that site's id, the server answers with a download link for the file.
The same thing happens for a site of the user's own company that they are not assigned to.
It matters because one customer can pull another customer's full electrical design, which is sensitive engineering data.
The export should be refused (the same as opening the site) for other companies' sites and for sites the user is not assigned to.

!ZP-4848-key-highlighted-v2.png|width=720!

h3. Actual result
The export request for another company's site answers 200, success true, with a download link (presigned_url) and the model size (375 equipment items, 193 connections). The same user is refused (422) when they try to open that site. The same happens for "Test site A", an Acme site this user is not assigned to: the export answers 200 with a download link, opening the site answers 422.

h3. Expected result
The export is refused (the same as opening the site) for other companies' sites and for sites the user is not assigned to.

h3. Test data
* Environment: https://acme.qa.egalvanic.ai, re-checked 14 Oct 2026 on build index-G6uKkjPx.js (screenshots) and again on index-D-HsTlcR.js after the afternoon redeploy (same result)
* Role / test login: Project Manager abhiyant.singh+project@egalvanic.com (a customer user, not staff; 116 sites)
* SLD page (type the address; this Project Manager has no SLD item in the menu, but the page opens): https://acme.qa.egalvanic.ai/slds
* Other company's site: "Saveland Avenue Lofts", id f86052b7-1683-431f-a86f-f52c6dd5be39 (not in Acme's site list; even the Acme Super Admin is refused when opening it)
* Acme site the user is NOT assigned to: "Test site A", id b99f9c84-a4d9-40fe-8f1b-7ef9e38de3f0
* The user's own site (control): "Android Site 2", id aadcee4c-7dd0-45b3-81b9-309c5c166084 -> 200 (correct)
* QA did not open the downloaded files.

h3. Steps to reproduce
1. Sign in to https://acme.qa.egalvanic.ai as the Project Manager abhiyant.singh+project@egalvanic.com.
2. Type https://acme.qa.egalvanic.ai/slds in the address bar and click *Export*. *Export Engineering XML* is the button that runs this export for the current site. (Screenshot 1, site "Android Site 2")
!ZP-4848-1-PM-14Oct-sld-export-menu-highlighted.png|width=720!
3. Open the browser console (F12) on the same page and run this for the other company's site "Saveland Avenue Lofts" (not in this user's site list):
{noformat}
fetch('/api/sld/f86052b7-1683-431f-a86f-f52c6dd5be39/export-skm',{method:'POST',headers:{'Content-Type':'application/json'},body:'{}'}).then(r=>r.json()).then(console.log)
{noformat}
4. The result is 200, success true, with a download link (presigned_url) and the model size (375 equipment items, 193 connections). (The key screenshot at the top)
5. Control, same user: opening that site is refused:
{noformat}
fetch('/api/sld/f86052b7-1683-431f-a86f-f52c6dd5be39').then(r=>console.log(r.status))   // 422 permission denied
{noformat}
6. Same check with the Acme site the user is NOT assigned to, "Test site A" (b99f9c84-a4d9-40fe-8f1b-7ef9e38de3f0): opening it is refused (422), but the export answers 200 with a download link.

h3. Notes for the developer
* {{export-skm}} is missing the company and site-assignment check that {{GET /api/sld/<id>}} already has.
* Controls: own site (aadcee4c-7dd0-45b3-81b9-309c5c166084) -> 200 (correct); a random id -> 400 "SLD not found".
* Same family as ZP-4709 / ZP-4723, different endpoint.
